description: This file defines the FeaturesController class, which manages feature-related UI state and interactions within a web application, including premium feature modals and entitlement checks.

classes.name: FeaturesController
classes.description: Controller class managing feature states, premium modals, and entitlement logic in the web application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, resets properties, and destroys object properties.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets up event handlers, and observable properties.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles internal events, specifically displaying the premium modal.

methods.name: showPremiumAlert
methods.description: Displays the premium feature alert modal for a given feature.

methods.name: showPurchaseSuccessAlert
methods.description: Sets the alert to indicate a successful purchase.

methods.name: closePremiumAlert
methods.description: Closes the premium feature alert modal.

methods.name: isEntitledToFiles
methods.description: Checks if the user is entitled to the Files feature.

methods.name: isEntitledToFolders
methods.description: Checks if the user is entitled to the TagNesting feature.

methods.name: isEntitledToSmartViews
methods.description: Checks if the user is entitled to the SmartFilters feature.
